summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Phase 5 features for Dinar Desk offline accounting app. All three major features (Suppliers Search, Expenses Filter by Type, and Partial Payment functionality) are fully functional and working as specified.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Made with Emergent' badge at bottom-right has z-index issue that can block clicks on the English language button
ui_bugs.workaround: Using force=True in Playwright bypasses the issue. Users can still click with slight adjustment.

passed_tests: ✅ Suppliers Page Search: Search input exists, filters by name (case-insensitive), filters by ID (SUP-XXXX or raw number), clear button works, empty state shows for no matches

✅ Expenses Page Filter by Type: Filter dropdown exists with 'All types' default, correctly filters by Food (2 entries, 70,000 IQD), Transport (2 entries, 40,000 IQD), Office (1 entry, 50,000 IQD), filtered total bar appears/hides correctly

✅ Partial Payment on Bill Add: Initial payment field exists, summary box shows remaining amount and safe balance, creates bill and auto-linked payment with '-INIT' suffix, safe balance updates correctly (5M - 160K expenses - 300K payment = 4.54M)

✅ Payment Modal Enhancements: Remaining info box appears with correct amount, Pay Remaining button exists and auto-fills amount, bill status updates to 'Paid' after full payment, safe balance updates correctly (4.54M - 700K = 3.84M)
✅ Validations: Pay Remaining button hidden for fully paid bills, error shown when payment exceeds remaining balance, error shown when initial payment exceeds bill amount
✅ Bill Dropdown: Shows remaining amounts in option text (format: 'B-XXXX · #BillNumber · Remaining: X IQD')
✅ Regression Tests: Safe balance calculations correct, language toggle EN/AR works with RTL layout, navigation works, data persists after reload, PDF export button exists
